legs.root_cause_isolated: Verified via a direct probe (job escape, then a short wait --menu poll outside the timing wait) that the menu genuinely remained open after the background job's escape - the job's keystroke did not dismiss it. The identical 'press escape --app notepad.exe' command run interactively (from the same foreground console invoking the CLI directly, not via Start-Job) DID dismiss the menu every time it was tried. wait --menu-closed's TIMEOUT was an honest report of true platform state (menu still open); the defect is upstream in key delivery from a background/non-interactive process context, not in the menu detector.
